# Markdown Web Clipper

> A Chrome (Manifest V3) extension that converts any webpage to high-fidelity
> Markdown — tables, code, math, footnotes — and saves it exactly where you keep
> your notes: local folder, clipboard, .md download, Obsidian, or GitHub Gist.
> Local-first, no cloud round-trip, no telemetry. Free & MIT-licensed; an
> optional one-time Pro upgrade adds Gist, co-located images, unlimited batch,
> and multi-vault routing.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://markdownwebclipper.com/): what it does, the five destinations, the fidelity before/after. ([Markdown](https://markdownwebclipper.com/index.md))
- [Pro FAQ](https://markdownwebclipper.com/pro-faq): pricing ($9 launch / $19 standard, one-time), what Pro unlocks, activation, restore, refunds. ([Markdown](https://markdownwebclipper.com/pro-faq.md))
- [Privacy](https://markdownwebclipper.com/privacy): exactly what data is read/written and the (minimal) remote calls. ([Markdown](https://markdownwebclipper.com/privacy.md))
